title: Final Transition Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the transition energy for the 2P to 1S state as 6.6 keV.

title: Probability Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately estimate the probability of finding the K- and proton within 10^-13 cm in the 1S state as approximately 3 x 10^-6.

title: Change in Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The student must determine the change in transition energy due to the strong interaction as approximately 150 eV.

title: Use of Reduced Mass
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the concept of reduced mass in the calculations.

title: Bohr Radius Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must compute the new Bohr radius correctly as approximately 77 fm.

title: Wavefunction Application
description: Important Criteria: The student should utilize the hydrogen wavefunction appropriately for the probability calculations.

title: Integration Method
description: Optional Criteria: The student may demonstrate understanding by simplifying the integration for the probability calculation.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid unit mistakes, ensuring all energies are in consistent units (e.g., MeV, eV).

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should be cautious of sign mistakes in energy calculations, particularly when applying perturbation theory.
